<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity Content">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment block with high structural complexity -->
  <sub:child>
    <?sub:pi processing-instruction-data?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <tag attr="val">&ent;</tag>
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  %ext;
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY nested-ent "&base-ent; and more">
  <?target data="test"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://w3.org/XML/1998/namespace" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment wrapping CDATA and entities -->
  <section xsi:schemaLocation="http://example.com schema.xsd">
    <?xml-stylesheet href="mystyle.css" title="Compact"?>
    <![CDATA[Nested CDATA block: <>&'"]]&nested-ent;
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author-name "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY % internal-pe "<!ENTITY pe-ent 'Parameter Entity Value'>">
  %internal-pe;
  <?xml-meta category="inventory"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:pub="http://example.org/pub">
  <!-- Inventory tracking comment -->
  <book pub:id="12345">
    <?pub:action type="refresh"?>
    <title>XML Parsing Techniques</title>
    <author>&author-name;</author>
    <![CDATA[
      Additional publishing notes &pe-ent;
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (employee*)>
  <!ELEMENT employee (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY dept-code "HR-99">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-frag "<!ENTITY frag-ent 'Fragment Value'>">
  %dtd-frag;
  <?corp-info status="active"?>
]>
<enterprise xmlns="http://enterprise.com/ns" xmlns:hr="http://enterprise.com/hr">
  <!-- Employee registry comment block -->
  <hr:department code="&dept-code;">
    <?hr:audit checked="true"?>
    <employee>
      <![CDATA[
        Confidential employee record: &frag-ent;
      ]]>
    </employee>
  </hr:department>
</enterprise>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (header, body)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY sec-token "SEC-TOKEN-XYZ">
  <!ENTITY % p-entity "<!ENTITY p-resolved 'Parameter Resolved'>">
  %p-entity;
  <?xml-log level="debug"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://schema.org/doc" xmlns:sec="http://schema.org/security">
  <!-- Security boundary check comment -->
  <header>
    <?sec:policy enforce="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Security payload with token: &sec-token; and &p-resolved;
    ]]>
  </header>
  <body>Standard document body text.</body>
</document>
```
